digest.component_or_area: ticket state schema and write surfaces (CLI, library, MCP)
propositions: Two new ticket state fields bridge_project (tri-state string) and repos (list of strings) must be added to schema, seeded in make_initial_state, and projected by the reducer from both CREATE and EDIT events

bridge_project and repos must be writable at create time via --bridge-project and --repos flags on all three write surfaces (CLI composer.create_cli, library _lib_writes, MCP _mcp_writes) with identical resulting state

bridge_project must be promote-only on the edit path: setting it on an unbound ticket succeeds, but setting it on a ticket that already holds a binding is refused with non-zero exit and no state change, while repos remains freely editable
The absent, explicit-empty string, and populated states of bridge_project must be distinguishable after full replay to support the tri-state pattern matching file_impact_scope
A ticket created before this change must replay to identical state apart from the two new keys to preserve backward compatibility
